- TOTAL revenue reached £68.7k TW versus £50.3k LW, a WoW gain of 36.6%.
- TOTAL units came in at 27,550 TW (+29.6% WoW) and TOTAL orders at 2,250 TW (+45.5% WoW).
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER ranked 1 TW with £4,443.21, equal to 6.5% of TOTAL revenue.
- PARTY BUNTING delivered £2,495.37 TW for a 3.6% share, up 55.9% WoW, while WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER posted £1,961.04 TW at a 2.9% share.
- The top five products combined for 17.6% of TOTAL revenue TW, including PINK AND LILAC QUILTED THROW at £1,825.90 and ENGLISH ROSE DESIGN QUILTED THROW at £1,350.97.
- Largest WoW gains came from PINK AND LILAC QUILTED THROW (+£1,779.95), ENGLISH ROSE DESIGN QUILTED THROW (+£1,350.97) and GIANT BLACK SUNGLASSES (+£1,319.10).
- Largest WoW declines were PLEASE ONE PERSON METAL SIGN (-£1,064.61), LUNCH BAG BLACK SKULL. (-£814.60) and TEA TIME CAKE STAND IN GIFT BOX (-£686.94).
- DOOR MAT UNION FLAG rose 43.0% WoW off an above-median LW base.
